coverage.rationale: The flagged FindSet iterates `ItemLedgerEntry`, a `var` parameter of IsFullTrackedOutputSetSupported that the caller (CopyTrackedSubcontractingOutputToSeparateInvoice) keeps using after the call: CopyItemLedgerEntriesUpToQuantity executes `TempItemLedgerEntry := ItemLedgerEntry` to buffer the whole entry for later item-tracking-specification creation, so narrowing the load to the loop's own six fields (as flagged) would drop fields that buffer still needs, exactly the caller-and-helpers caveat the cited article already states. The developer's negative feedback rejects the suggestion for this reason, not because SetLoadFields is unwanted in general, so the guard is scoped to this var-parameter/round-trip-return case and does not claim SetLoadFields is never applicable to Item Ledger Entry reads elsewhere in the file.
